Nintendo Black Star Promos

Released October 1, 2003 · 40 cards

Nintendo Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the NP series, released in English on October 1, 2003. It has 40 cards. It includes 36 Pokémon, 4 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

15 illustrators worked on Nintendo Black Star Promos. Most cards: Atsuko Nishida (6), Ken Sugimori (5), Kouki Saitou (5), Ryo Ueda (5), Kagemaru Himeno (4), Mitsuhiro Arita (3), Sumiyoshi Kizuki (3), Hajime Kusajima (2).
